description: Migration script for version 5.2.0 of the OrangeHRM system. Defines class 'Migration' with methods to update database schema, insert permissions and language strings, and clean up data related to the system's upgrade process.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Handles database schema updates and data migrations for OrangeHRM version 5.2.0, including permission setups, language string updates, and database cleanup tasks.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration steps such as schema changes, permission insertions, language string updates, and cleanup.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of the migration: '5.2.0'.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Provides an instance of LangStringHelper, initializing it if not already available.

methods.name: updatePimLeftMenuConfigurators
methods.description: Updates the PIM left menu configuration to use the new configurator class.

methods.name: updateOrganizationStructure
methods.description: Updates the organization structure's top-level name based on database info.

methods.name: updateHomePage
methods.description: Updates homepage URLs for specified user roles.

methods.name: insertLDAPMenuItem
methods.description: Inserts LDAP configuration item into the menu.

methods.name: cleanLDAPAddonData
methods.description: Deletes LDAP related data group, screen, and module entries to clean up previous LDAP configurations.

methods.name: insertLangStringNotes
methods.description: Inserts notes into language strings from a YAML file.

methods.name: cleanI18nGroups
methods.description: Removes specific internationalization groups and reassigns associated language strings.
